texts: Myocardial viability before reoperation is assessed with nuclear stress imaging, magnetic resonance imaging, dobutamine echocardiography and cardiac PET scanning.
Coronary angiography shows the anatomy of the arteries and grafts, not whether the muscle they supply is alive: D is the answer.
Viable but hibernating muscle is worth revascularizing; scar is not.
Memory hook: the lamp, the magnet, the doberman with the bat and the glowing puppy all examine the bear, while the photographer photographs only the pipes.
